chapterInfo.content:
1
Onyankopɔn dɔ Israel
1AWURADE atemmusɛm a ɔnam Malaki so de brɛɛ Israel nie.
2 # Gye 25.23; Rom 9.13 Madɔ mo, AWURADE na ɔseɛ. Na mobisa sɛ: Wode deɛn na adɔ yɛn? Esau nyɛ Yakob nua? AWURADE asɛm nie; nanso medɔɔ Yakob, 3#Yes 34.13 na metanee Esau, na mayɛ ne mmepɔ no afo, ne n’agyapadeɛ nso ayɛ anwea pradada so ɛserɛ so kraman adeɛ. 4Sɛ Edom ka sɛ: Wɔapɛkyɛ yɛn, nanso yɛbɛsane akɔ akɔsisi agoago no a, sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Wɔn deɛ, wɔbɛsisi, na me nso, mɛdwiri, na wɔafrɛ wɔn sɛ: Abɔnefosɛm hyeɛ, ne: Ɔman a AWURADE afa wɔn abufuo de rekɔsi daa. 5Na mo ani bɛhunu, na mo deɛ, mobɛka sɛ: AWURADE kɛseyɛ tra Israel hyeɛ no so.
Asɔfoɔ no anibiannasoɔ
6 # Eks 20.12; Yoh 8.49 Ɔba di n’agya ni, na akoa di ne wura ni. Na sɛ agya ne me a, m’anidie wɔ he? Na sɛ owura ne me a, me suro wɔ he? Asafo AWURADE na ɔreka akyerɛ mo, asɔfoɔ a mobu me din animtia. Na mobisa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn mu na yɛbu wo din animtia? 7Mode paanoo a ɛho akum brɛ me m’afɔrebukyia so. Na moka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛde kum wo ho? Sɛ mosusu sɛ: AWURADE pono no yɛ adeɛ a wɔtumi bu no animtia. 8#Lew 22.20, 23 Na sɛ mode aboa anifirani bi ba bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ a, ɛnyɛ bɔne anaa? Na sɛ mode apakye anaa ɔyarefoɔ bi ba a, ɛnyɛ bɔne anaa? Fa kɔma w’amrado; na hwɛ sɛ n’ani bɛsɔ wo, anaasɛ ɔbɛhwɛ w’anim anaa? Asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 9Wiɛ, monkoto nsrɛ Nyankopɔn, na ɔmmɛdom yɛn ɛ. Na sɛ mo nsam na ɛno firiiɛ a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mo nti ɔbɛhwɛ obi anim? Asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 10#Mal 2.13; Yes 1.13 Anka ɛyɛ sɛ mo mu bi kɔtoto apono mu nso, na moansɔ m’afɔrebukyia so gya kwa! m’ani nsɔ mo hwee, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na mo nsam ayɛyɛdeɛ nyɛ me fɛ. 11#Yes 60.1-7 Na ɛfiri owiapueeɛ de kɔsi n’atɔeɛ no me din yɛ kɛseɛ amanaman mu, na wɔhye aduhwam bɔ afɔdeɛ ma me din mmaa nyinaa, na wɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɛho teɛ ba; na me din yɛ kɛseɛ amanaman mu, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 12Nanso mogu ho fi, sɛ moka sɛ: AWURADE pono no, wɔakum ho, ne ɛso adeɛ, n’aduane no nso yɛ adeɛ a wɔtumi bu no animtia. 13Nso moka sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔbrɛ bɛn nie! Na mopeepee, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na mode fomfa adeɛ ne aboa apakye ne ɔyarefoɔ ba, na mode bɛyɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ; mɛgye no mo nsam ama no ayɛ me fɛ anaa? AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 14#Lew 22.19 Nnome nka deɛ ɔsisie, ɔde onini a ɔwɔ ne nnwankuo mu hyɛ bɔ, nanso ɔde deɛ watɔ ape bɔ AWURADE afɔdeɛ no; ɛfiri sɛ ɔhenkɛseɛ ne me, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na me din ho yɛ hu, amanaman mu.

AWURADE atemmusɛm a ɔnam Malaki so de brɛɛ Israel nie.
Madɔ mo, AWURADE na ɔseɛ. Na mobisa sɛ: Wode deɛn na adɔ yɛn? Esau nyɛ Yakob nua? AWURADE asɛm nie; nanso medɔɔ Yakob, na metanee Esau, na mayɛ ne mmepɔ no afo, ne n’agyapadeɛ nso ayɛ anwea pradada so ɛserɛ so kraman adeɛ. Na mo ani bɛhunu, na mo deɛ, mobɛka sɛ: AWURADE kɛseyɛ tra Israel hyeɛ no so.

Ɔba di n’agya ni, na akoa di ne wura ni. Na sɛ agya ne me a, m’anidie wɔ he? Na sɛ owura ne me a, me suro wɔ he? Asafo AWURADE na ɔreka akyerɛ mo, asɔfoɔ a mobu me din animtia. Na mobisa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn mu na yɛbu wo din animtia? Mode paanoo a ɛho akum brɛ me m’afɔrebukyia so. Na moka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛde kum wo ho? Sɛ mosusu sɛ: AWURADE pono no yɛ adeɛ a wɔtumi bu no animtia. Asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. Wiɛ, monkoto nsrɛ Nyankopɔn, na ɔmmɛdom yɛn ɛ. Na sɛ mo nsam na ɛno firiiɛ a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mo nti ɔbɛhwɛ obi anim? Asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. Anka ɛyɛ sɛ mo mu bi kɔtoto apono mu nso, na moansɔ m’afɔrebukyia so gya kwa! m’ani nsɔ mo hwee, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na mo nsam ayɛyɛdeɛ nyɛ me fɛ. Nanso mogu ho fi, sɛ moka sɛ: AWURADE pono no, wɔakum ho, ne ɛso adeɛ, n’aduane no nso yɛ adeɛ a wɔtumi bu no animtia. Nso moka sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔbrɛ bɛn nie! Na mopeepee, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na mode fomfa adeɛ ne aboa apakye ne ɔyarefoɔ ba, na mode bɛyɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ; mɛgye no mo nsam ama no ayɛ me fɛ anaa? AWURADE na ɔseɛ. Nnome nka deɛ ɔsisie, ɔde onini a ɔwɔ ne nnwankuo mu hyɛ bɔ, nanso ɔde deɛ watɔ ape bɔ AWURADE afɔdeɛ no; ɛfiri sɛ ɔhenkɛseɛ ne me, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na me din ho yɛ hu, amanaman mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
